operator_superposition.reference: superposition and scaling against Y = S W^T (float64 numpy hand formula; seed 100)

csd_flat_potential_zero.reference: zero: second difference of a constant (all 8 contacts)

poisson_1d_flux_span.reference: Gauss's law: flux zero outside [src, sink) and constant inside (N = 81, absolute)
